findings.detail: A07 observed pct_sum is 0.0%, but the source industry percentage schedule has populated percentage rows totaling 100.00%.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate check. The queue flag reports pct_sum=0.0% for 0002052152 at 2025-12-31. Raw source table 36 is the industry percentage schedule for total investments at fair value and shows individual industry percentages with a Grand Total of 100.00%, so the extracted zero aggregate is inconsistent with the filing schedule rather than a true zero in the filing.
